target.title: fix(gateway): clamp restart drain timers when deferral is oversized
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Safe gateway restarts can accept an oversized `gateway.reload.deferralTimeoutMs` value, but Node timers cannot represent delays above the platform-safe maximum. Without clamping, restart drain waits can arm overflowing timers and force the restart path before the configured drain budget is actually honored.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the restart drain budget inside the existing Node-safe timer contract at the restart resolver boundary, then applies the same timer-safe normalization in the two process-level drain waiters that can also be called directly. The change preserves `0` as the indefinite/immediate sentinel for the existing restart paths, preserves positive fractional `waitForActiveTasks` behavior by clamping it to a real timer, and does not add config, schema, protocol, or provider behavior.

This is AI-assisted.

## User Impact

Operators who configure a very large restart deferral budget get a bounded, timer-safe drain instead of an early timeout caused by Node timer overflow.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: oversized safe-restart drain budgets and direct process drain waiter timeouts clamp to `MAX_TIMER_TIMEOUT_MS`, while zero/indefinite and positive fractional wait behavior stay intact.
- Current-head proof at `c8597646e498365fab7c086df3e2fcf083d54819`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/process/gateway-work-admission.test.ts src/process/command-queue.test.ts` passed with 55 tests.
- Current-head proof at `c8597646e498365fab7c086df3e2fcf083d54819`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/restart.test.ts -t resolveGatewayRestartDeferralTimeoutMs` passed with 1 selected test.
- Branch diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Observed result: restart deferral resolution, root-work drain waits, and active-task drain waits now use the shared Node-safe timer maximum for oversized finite values.
